{{Quote|I guess you'll have to go get it from the smugglers. They're called Mountaintop smugglers. Their leader is Janelle. You'll have to go fight them to get the ring back. And if you win, maybe I won't have to pay any of the rest of what I owe them.|[[Herman Pate]], to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />}}
'''Janelle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of the [[Mountaintop smugglers]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she acquired a ring from [[Herman Pate]] as a payment of a debt. The ring was a family heirloom previously lost by [[Vance Groten]] to Herman Pate during a [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] game. As Groten intended to recover his ring, he dispatched a spacer to find the smuggler leader. Janelle was killed in the confrontation.<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Janelle was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DVGaF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Janelle was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
